agent_output_snapshot.intro: An original gold Maleficent-inspired costume built around a fitted bodysuit, dramatic horn headpiece and full-length leg pieces for stage, cosplay and show performance.

pdp_blocks.body: This is an original glamorous interpretation of a horned Maleficent-inspired character. A fitted gold bodysuit forms the base, the headpiece defines the fantasy character, and long leg elements built from repeated shapes suggest a mix of scales and skeletal armor down the legs.
pdp_blocks.heading: About this piece

pdp_blocks.body:
Gold vegan leather gives the costume a polished surface that catches surrounding highlights as the performer moves.
Transparent silicone straps keep the fastening visually light, letting the gold shapes stay prominent.
The older horn version has a fuller, more enclosed design, while the newer version is simpler and more open; both are available in the selector.
The fitted bodysuit and long leg elements make the costume read clearly across a stage while keeping the major pieces modular.
pdp_blocks.heading: Why you'll love it

pdp_blocks.body:
GoGo dancers, showgirls and show-ballet performers building a glamorous fantasy character.
Stage appearances where the horned headpiece needs to carry the identity of the look.
Halloween and cosplay with a polished Maleficent-inspired direction.
Music video, event and editorial styling that calls for an attention-focused gold costume.
pdp_blocks.heading: Ideal for

pdp_blocks.body: The look combines a fitted gold base with an expressive horn headpiece and long segmented leg details, giving the character a refined fantasy edge that feels made for performance. TheFEYA treats the Maleficent inspiration as a starting point for an original handmade stage design with its own proportions, finish and character.
pdp_blocks.heading: Designed for self-expression
